title: Latency bifurcation bloomboard: p50/p95/p99 + streaming vs non-streaming
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary:
Build a new interactive latency 'bifurcation bloomboard' that surfaces p50/p95/p99 breakdowns by model and route with a clear split between streaming (server-sent chunks) and non-streaming (sync) requests. The board must link to traces (trace-hooks) and show error-rate overlays so SREs and product owners can quickly identify regressions and rollout impacts.

Motivation:
- Current dashboards show aggregate percentiles but make it hard to understand whether tails are driven by streaming IO, model kernels, or route-level behavior.
- Engineering and product teams need an investigatory-first surface that connects time-series metrics, sampled traces, and raw logs for suspect cohorts.

Goals / Deliverables:
1) Cookbook telemetry schema addition: add route_id, model_family, io_mode (streaming|sync|batch), request_shape_bucket to token-level metrics and log enrichment.
2) Metrics pipeline: extend metrics ingestion to compute per-minute p50/p95/p99 by (route_id, model_family, io_mode) and emit to metrics-store with tags for quick aggregation.
3) Trace hooks: a lightweight trace-link header that is automatically attached to sampled traces; dashboard panels should offer one-click "open traces" that includes the request_shape and KV cache hit fraction.
4) Bloomboard UI: Grafana (or Console) dashboard with interactive cohort composer (date range, model_family, route, io_mode), stacked percentile heatmap, and an error-rate ribbon aligned to percentiles.
5) Playbook snippets: quick triage steps, recommended queries, and a sample alert rule for p95 increase > 25% sustained for 10m for high-traffic routes.

Implementation notes / plan:
- Telemetry schema: add fields to logs/metrics pipeline in the upstream ingestion lambda (see confluence doc). Backfill not required for 30d retention window.
- Sampling: keep trace sampling rate per route at 1% by default, bump to 5% for routes with p95 > threshold during alert windows.
- Aggregation window: compute percentiles using t-digest in the pipeline (per-minute) to scale across high-volume routes.
- Storage: keep 90-day aggregated percentile timeseries and 7-day high-resolution (1m) window. Raw spans keep 14 days.

Acceptance criteria:
- Dashboard displays p50/p95/p99 for selected route+model+io_mode and updates within 60s of ingestion.
- Clicking a percentile region opens the linked trace (if sampled) with contextual tags (route_id, model_family, io_mode, request_shape_bucket).
- Error rate panel overlays align with percentile shifts and can be toggled on/off.
- Alerts fire correctly based on the playbook thresholds in a staging environment.

Rollout plan:
1) Instrumentation + pipeline changes merged behind feature flag (ENG-428319-telemetry-flag).
2) Canary: enable feature flag for internal staging routes for 48h and validate percentiles vs offline SQL baseline.
3) Gradual rollout: 10% production routes -> 50% -> 100% over 3 days, monitor metrics and costs.
4) Full enable + dashboard published to Console.

Risks and mitigations:
- Increased cardinality in metrics: mitigate by bucketing request_shape and using model_family instead of exact model id for dashboard rollups.
- Trace volume cost: use adaptive sampling and conditional sampling on percentile deviation.
- Dashboard performance: precompute heavy aggregations and cache panels with 30s TTL.

Related artifacts and links:
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Bifurcation+Bloomboard
- Metrics schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/1423
- Pipeline job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/jobs/metric-aggregator
- Draft Grafana dashboard (staging): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/obs/bloomboard-staging
- Playbook doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Latency+Triage+Playbook

Notes on queries (examples):
- Percentile aggregation SQL (for offline verification):
  SELECT route_id, model_family, io_mode, tdigest_percentile(td, 0.95) as p95 FROM model_latency_tdigest WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY route_id, model_family, io_mode;
- Error overlay sample:
  SELECT ts_bucket, sum(errors)/sum(requests) FROM route_error_by_min WHERE route_id = 'chat.v1' GROUP BY ts_bucket ORDER BY ts_bucket;
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 per (route_id, model_family, io_mode) within 60s. 2) Trace link opens with contextual tags. 3) Error-rate overlay aligns and is toggleable. 4) Alerts trigger in staging according to playbook.
